state_authority: Existing CORE_DB Mongo application custody; pure snapshots have no independent storage authority

public_api.checkpoint: Synchronous on_checkpoint(snapshot,event), including dispatch_reserved BEFORE IO and outcome AFTER IO. Rejected final checkpoint restores last committed reservation; no uncharged network retry. Callback must resolve ambiguous storage outcomes before releasing physical worker.
public_api.scope: Exact tenant_id/owner_id immutable binding; application authenticates, authorizes and fences unexpired lease/version/source authority
public_api.evidence: CrawlRun.search(query,limit<=8): exact offset-anchored preserved-text passages, lexical ranking and untrusted-instruction review signals; no provider call or factual verification

semantics.robots: Fail closed on unavailable robots other than explicit 404/410; accept text/plain rules, not unexpected HTML; revalidation, TTL and every redirect target; delays checkpointed. Retry-After cannot reopen an origin before its valid remote deadline within the finite consent window. Denials and overload bodies never become discovery inputs.
semantics.dedupe: Canonical URL and full normalized content SHA256; exact aliases recorded with charged source provenance and never independent corroboration. Original primary remains immutable.
semantics.provenance: Actual requested/final URL, status, timestamps, raw body SHA256, full normalized text SHA256, preserved text SHA256/truncation and consent binding; no raw response bytes retained
semantics.learning: Bounded lexical evidence observations and exact-span retrieval under existing mission-quality functions, explicitly unreviewed external content. No verified knowledge, calibration, XP, model updates or training rights.
semantics.durability: Request slot and maximum possible response bytes are checkpointed BEFORE network as pending_dispatch; outcome atomically settles known bytes and content. Uncertain outcome retains reservation across recovery; committed source IDs dedupe. Full frontier, robots, retry timers and source text in same application snapshot.
semantics.recovery: Backend fences old worker and exact observed session revision before restore. Stale automated stop, retry or integrity-block writes cannot override newer owner/grant state. Pending dispatch becomes unknown outcome with full cap retained and bounded retry; external IO is at-least-once, not exactly-once. Deferred redirected-robots target cooldown is checkpointed rather than discarded.
semantics.control: Explicit pause/resume/cancel; no OS idle/activity inference; consent must remain current before network and commit
semantics.accounting: usage.bytes is measured accepted transport-body bytes; usage.reserved_bytes is conservative allowance for in-flight or unknown failed response bytes. Both consume total byte budget. Request count is reserved dispatch attempts, not independently attested remote server requests.
semantics.instruction_boundary: External text, titles, agent instruction artifacts, markup and arbitrary robots comments are inert; heuristic hits are held before discovery or retention. Owner-scoped incident receipts contain bounded pattern categories and permitted hashes, never raw instruction payloads. No-store/noindex/noarchive suppress retained fingerprints. Existing robots rules narrow admission and are not ignored. Ordinary retrieval and source-use controls cannot release quarantined material.
semantics.adaptive_navigation: Only already-admitted due frontier rows may be reordered by bounded operator relevance, URL coverage and committed origin outcomes. Host failure streak can extend cooldown but never shorten robots, Retry-After or grant bounds; explicit access denial stops host acquisition for current consent. FIFO remains compatible. Redirects and restored targets undergo structural trap checks; no new URL authority.
semantics.autonomous_application: Application may consume explicit finite CORE_DB grants through the existing backend scheduler. Pure run_slice remains at most4steps/45seconds; no independent pure background loop, storage, scheduler or authority. Canonical code binding and pre-IO reservation remain unchanged.
semantics.protocol_matching: Bounded merged exact product-group rules, wildcard/terminal matching, percent-octet normalization; strictest valid selected pacing, fail closed on invalid pacing or match work exhaustion. Runtime-only parser cache must match snapshot text and time; first-page and redirect Retry-After pacing enforced.
semantics.frontier_index: Ephemeral query and source URL coverage projection built once per selection; no stored cross-owner index or authority.
semantics.offline_benchmark: Eight strategies and four deterministic corpora (96 planned fixture runs at 3 repetitions), including mirror and keyword-padding controls. Fixed synthetic transport latency bucket is not a performance measurement; real wall runtime reported separately. No third-party engine executed.
semantics.parser_containment: Complex document and structured discovery parsing in disposable POSIX resource-limited children, with finite input/output, deadline, restricted environment and Python audit defense. Parent reconstructs custody and admits links. No same-response network retry for parser faults. Small simple text remains in-process; PDF has existing child. Non-POSIX complex parsing holds; not an OS sandbox.
semantics.retrieval_diversity: Bounded exact-span lexical candidates, duplicate passage suppression and deterministic relevance-weighted novelty/origin ranking, rechecked owner and source custody. No new source authority or model training.
semantics.checkpoint_redundancy: Each snapshot publication atomically includes exact-current identity witness and bounded compressed duplicate when total admitted storage envelope permits. Quiescent current-consent owner CAS repair only, exact runtime and scope validated; no ancestor rollback, new worker, revocation bypass or recovery if both fields are lost. Redundancy erased with owner session; not independent backup.
semantics.acquisition_feedback: One bounded settled observation per charged request, conservation of known and uncertain bytes across pending-dispatch recovery, quantized transport latency excluding checkpoint and extraction time. Adaptive tail/EMA pacing adds holds and never overrides server or operator policy.
semantics.information_portfolio: Coverage strategy combines indexed URL exploration and actual retained source term coverage, distinct hostname support, rarity, cost-adjusted marginal expected yield and conservatively shrunk host reward. No source text creates new authority. FIFO and original balanced remain selectable.
semantics.adaptive_extraction: Structural HTML main/article and density inference chooses only high-confidence source-order projections or preserves prior extraction on ambiguity. Existing semantic enrichments and canonical link admission remain. Source hashes bind retained projected wording; no independent verification.
semantics.resource_governor: Kernel-reported memory/cgroup/CPU/pressure headroom narrows existing physical slice credit ceiling with immediate downscale and gradual recovery. Unsupported metrics restrict local capacity to one; measured critical pressure may stop new admissions. Existing leases remain authoritative.
semantics.companion_evolution: Evidence-derived, reversible, lexical-quality-weighted source novelty, diminishing same-origin credit, bounded continuous-script tokenization, no XP for requests, denials, time elapsed, or inactivity. Five forms; four explicit temperament modes; no independent authority, training, or background work.
semantics.companion_questbook: Twelve prerequisite-constrained achievements across discovery, scholarship, ecology and stewardship. Exact source capture identity/sequence; quest progress derived, not independently persisted. Source references filtered by current owner policy.
semantics.companion_curriculum: Confidence-shrunk host novelty/recent learning progress, bounded remaining-information and novelty exploration, maximum 12 percent priority contribution annealed by remaining budgets. Guardian weight halved. Policy, budget, DNS, robots, cooldown and owner lease gates remain canonical. Pre-dispatch choice receipt conserved through settled outcomes and uncertain recovery.
semantics.companion_sanctuary: Explicit owner read derives current-consent collection across eight version-fenced witnessed expeditions and sixteen current captures each; exact/near duplication, lexical density and per-origin saturation. Source-use withdrawal and expiry exclude candidates. No source text, durable XP wallet, network authority, or snapshot mutation. Not an atomic transaction; concurrent revision changes detected by final version fence.
semantics.companion_visual: Existing animated companion receives five evidence-derived evolution stages, shell morph and palette, completed-quest cosmetics, reduced motion, power-aware rendering and decorative pet interaction; no independent training or work.
semantics.treasury: Exact fetched URL and representation family; independent current/historic BM25 populations, ordered content-defined section digests and numeric drift, deduplicated transition stewardship, immutable re-observation and rollback lineage. Newer unavailable or variant-unknown conflicting alias blocks current promotion. Retained text read only under current source-use or explicit bounded archive rights; no training or new capture permission.
semantics.treasury_revisit: Bounded 31-grid interval-censored posterior with exposure, contradictory timestamp holds, publisher hint postponement, origin-balanced cost-aware suggestions; new expedition requires explicit fresh grant. No automatic cross-session dispatch.
semantics.hoarder: Six forms and 60 display levels; final form requires discovery >=800, sufficient distinct verified history transitions in multiple families, current coverage, and effective evolution >=1150. No reward for mirrored or oscillating content. Animated level-based breathing, blink, cozy poses, props and treasure den.
semantics.treasury_materialization: Grant-bound compressed per-session lexical fingerprints; no plaintext archive duplicate. Explicit source-policy updates invalidate the derivative; bounded maintenance removes expired derived segments while preserving capture records.
semantics.treasury_legacy: Original witnessed terminal snapshots can be separately verified for explicit history-only use without changing code, request, binding or snapshot digests. Never restore legacy execution or expand network/model rights.
semantics.treasury_watch: Owner/editor explicitly authorizes a finite single public URL watch. Deterministic child identity, cycle/slice charges, live parent/policy/principal and exact worker pulse token fences. Existing canonical robots, DNS, scope, request and physical leases remain governing. No automatic renewal.
semantics.treasury_temporal_selection: 32-session owner catalogue, 2048 observations and 256 retained-text candidates. Selected-family and cutoff-first reservation, fair chronological version representatives, partition-bound pagination, past-cutoff historic-only results; held newest revisions cannot promote older different material.
semantics.treasury_vault: Owner-explicit expired terminal retirement; reserve existing owner quota vault ID before row publication and active slot release. Metadata-only catalog, bounded selected history-only windows; no new permission, backup or physical storage. Exact owner erase removes both quota IDs.
semantics.treasury_quota_audit: Metadata-only owner quota reconciliation, exact arrays and immutable erased tombstones; missing reservations and malformed records held, never guessed deleted.
semantics.treasury_vault_discovery: Query-guided page-local discovery over up to 128 retired records, eight exact witnessed sessions per request; live archive membership, no source text, no context or network permission; catalogue/version/active-grant cursor binding.
semantics.treasury_vault_care: Explicit maintenance grant, at most seven days/three exact-copy repairs; atomic grant/version/lease consumption and repair; no acquisition or source-use authority.
semantics.treasury_vault_care_history: Same-row finite version-bound hash-linked grant/withdrawal/automatic repair receipts; unknown legacy prefix and held malformed history; no source access or independent audit authority.
semantics.deep_archive: Witnessed partition reserve/publish/release; grant-bound indexed routing and exact historical reparse. Physical capacity unverified.
semantics.treasury_archive_routing: Owner-scoped multikey inverted candidate index automatically built from qualified archive posting segments, rechecked original bytes and per-source grants; pointers only, bounded partial candidate ranking.
semantics.source_catalogue: Candidate metadata only; the optional operator-reviewed local immutable SQLite generation is tied to packaged catalogue and checkpoint identity. Export provenance and distinct URLs are not verified source access, publisher authority, crawl consent or acquired content. Bounded origin-diverse candidate lanes; no global recall guarantee. Existing dispatch, robots and authorization boundaries unchanged.

network.direct: Validated public DNS addresses pinned to socket with original TLS SNI/hostname verification
network.configured_proxy: Inherited explicit HTTP(S)_PROXY settings with HTTP proxy endpoints; preserve original origin hostname in absolute URI/CONNECT and TLS SNI, public-origin DNS admission. Proxy resolves origin connection; do not claim origin-peer pinning. HTTPS proxy endpoints unsupported fail-closed. No proxy endpoint/credentials exported.
network.credentials: No caller headers, cookies, authorization, source URL userinfo or custom origin ports; no provider SDK/model call. Stable crawler product identification; no tenant or owner identifiers in request headers; no anti-bot circumvention or identity rotation.

resolver.implementation: bounded isolated stdlib Python DNS helper; minimal noncredential environment; maximum eight helpers; bounded response; deadline termination and wait; retain capacity for any unconfirmed process until reaped
resolver.authority: No new service/store/scheduler/runtime owner; configured proxy hostname may resolve privately as deployment trusted endpoint, origin DNS must resolve exclusively publicly

verification: Exact-head offline adversarial and recovery regression suites, equal-budget deterministic coverage fixture, frontend protocol validation/typecheck, architecture/security/mirror checks, independent authorized network and device qualification required. Benchmark superiority is unqualified; no closure or signoff implied.
